label: Modbus → InfluxDB
info:
Starter collector: polls a Modbus/TCP device, decodes and validates registers, writes points to InfluxDB.

Conventions used here:
- Hosts, org, bucket and token come from container env vars ($(VAR)), never hard-coded.
- All decoding/scaling/range limits live in ONE function node (register map at the top).
- Each point is built explicitly (measurement, tags, fields, timestamp) so the schema is under your control.
- Errors are written as 'collector_events' points; Catch scopes are explicit to avoid error feedback loops.
- A 60 s heartbeat point lets Grafana alert on 'collector went silent'.

name: 1) Poll & decode
info: Edit the register map in 'Decode & validate'. Poll rate/addresses are set in the Modbus Read node. The Modbus host comes from MODBUS_HOST.

name: Decode & validate
2) Errors → events (scoped, no feedback loop)
info: This Catch only watches the Modbus read and the decoder. Influx write errors are caught separately and only logged, because writing an error event to a broken database would just fail again.

name: Error → event point
3) Heartbeat (alert in Grafana if this stops)
info: Counters are cumulative since the Node-RED process started (flow context, in memory).

name: Heartbeat point
